consequence.statement: The InfluxDB v1 metrics configuration (metrics.influxDB / --metrics.influxDB) is now unsupported, and leaving it in the static configuration prevents Traefik from starting.
consequence.remediation: Remove all InfluxDB v1 metrics provider configuration from the static configuration.

assertion.statement: InfluxDB v1: InfluxDB v1.x maintenance ended in 2021

evidence.locator: L502-L526 (Migration Guide: From v2 to v3 › Static configuration › InfluxDB v1)
evidence.excerpt:
### InfluxDB v1

InfluxDB v1.x maintenance [ended in 2021](https://www.influxdata.com/blog/influxdb-oss-and-enterprise-roadmap-update-from-influxdays-emea/).
In v3, the InfluxDB v1 metrics provider has been removed.

??? example "An example of Traefik v2 InfluxDB v1 metrics configuration"

    ```yaml tab="File (YAML)"
    metrics:
      influxDB: {}
    ```

    ```toml tab="File (TOML)"
    [metrics.influxDB]
    ```

    ```bash tab="CLI"
    --metrics.influxDB=true
    ```

This configuration is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start.
